description: Djambistraat 1-35 (BAG 1913): 5.5-6.0 m dark brick fronts of a 3.3 m ground storey and three 3.0 m upper storeys under a light gutter at 12.7 m; three axes per front, two tall white-framed windows with a top light and, on the door side against the party wall, one round-arched window that pairs with the neighbour's across the wall; the paired house doors stand under the arched pair; one pointed brick dormer with a small light per front on the steep tiled roof

match.note: BAG 1913 on 16 of 16 Djambistraat 1-35 pands, eaves 12.6-13.1 m, ridge 15.5-16.1 m; the arched pair straddles the party wall so every second front is the mirror of the first (mirrorForDoor right: a door on the left is mirrored). The even side of Djambistraat (a low three-storey row) is a different design and fails the storey count

brick-dormer.note: Djambistraat 11-13: a pointed brick dormer 2.0 m wide over the tall pair, small light, apex 15.1 m over the 12.9 m gutter; the 0.85 m two-light window sits in the brick front on a 0.15 m apron (dormerWindow)

door-right.note: the house door under the arched window, at the party wall; paired with the neighbour's door

rhythm.bays: 3 axes: window, window, arched window on the door side
rhythm.identicalBays: equal windows; the arched one narrower
rhythm.symmetry: mirror pairs about the party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: paired house doors under the arched pair
rhythm.roofline: light gutter, a pointed brick dormer per front
